truth_boundary: CAD bounding-box CALC with the pod carrier removed and the folding handle re-posed about its modeled hinge axis. Not a physical fit test, and informational only -- does not gate the overall build. Corner suspension stroke is not parked/retracted in this pose, so this is a partial, conservative (upper-bound) estimate of the true folded envelope.

trunk_cargo_opening_reference_mm_ASSUMED.reason: Representative mid-size sedan/hatchback trunk cargo opening; typical published figures fall in the 900-1100 mm width x 650-800 mm height range. Not a specific vehicle's measured opening.

stroller_folded_footprint_reference_mm_A.reason: Representative folded footprint of a full-size (non-umbrella) consumer stroller; typical published folded dimensions fall in the 750-950 mm length x 500-650 mm width x 280-420 mm height range. Not a specific product's measured spec.

open_items: Corner suspension is not commanded to a retracted/parked stroke in this pose -- would need a real parked-pose CAD export before this is a production fold spec. Closes when the corner actuators get a sourced parked/retracted position and a corresponding CAD pose.
The removed pod's own standalone envelope (as a carried car-seat-style unit) is not separately reported here. Closes with a dedicated pod-only bounding-box CALC.
Trunk and stroller reference dimensions above are representative figures, not measurements of a specific target vehicle or competitor product. Closes when a specific target trunk/vehicle is sourced.
